title: Consolidated marketplace metadata sync and launch runbook for AWS/Azure/GCP
creator: Maya Chen
description:
Goal: Ship synchronized marketplace listings and coordinated release notes for AWS Marketplace, Azure Marketplace, and GCP Marketplace with a single launch date and consistent metadata so customers see the same product messaging, pricing, and SKUs across clouds.

Scope:
- Prepare listing metadata (description, long description, icons, architecture diagrams, FAQs) for each marketplace console.
- Map our pricing tiers and billing SKUs to marketplace SKU models and confirm billing flows with Finance.
- Finalize exportable screenshots and short promo video (60s) optimized per marketplace specs.
- Coordinate release notes and changelog publication across Docs, Console release notes, SDK changelogs, and marketplace listing notes.
- Ensure legal & compliance signoff (T&Cs, data transfer, KMS/HSM statements) and required attestation documents for each marketplace.
- Validate E2E install/subscribe flow in each marketplace (test accounts) and smoke tests for provisioning + activation.
- Create a launch runbook (on-call, rollback steps, emergency contact list, dashboard links).

Acceptance criteria:
- Marketplace listings live on AWS/Azure/GCP with identical product title, short description, and core feature bullets.
- All three listings pass their respective marketplace validation checks and legal attestations.
- Pricing and SKU mapping signed off by Finance and QA for billing reconciliation.
- Release notes published in Docs site and Console, and cross-linked from each marketplace listing.
- Smoke tests (provisioning -> token issuance -> first 100 requests) pass for each cloud region in scope.
- Launch runbook reviewed and acknowledged by Eng on-call and Support triage leads.

Key stakeholders:
- PM: Maya Chen (owner)
- Release assignee: Alejandro Ruiz
- Eng leads: Samir Patel (runtime), Lena Brooks (billing), Hugo Martinez (infra)
- Design: Priya Nambiar (assets), Rahul Desai (screens)
- Legal/Compliance: Eleanor Shaw
- Growth/Marketing: Jordan Park
- Finance: Claire Osei

Artifacts and links:
- Draft runbook (Confluence): https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/MARKET/Marketplace+Launch+Runbook
- Listing copy spreadsheet (Drive): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/marketplace-copy-2026
- PR for marketplace UI mapping: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/2147
- Billing SKU mapping doc: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1BillingMapping2026
- Test matrix & smoke results (internal dashboard): https://app.redwood.ai/dashboards/marketplace-smoke

Risks and mitigations:
- Marketplace validation delays: start pre-submission checks with marketplace reps 7 business days prior.
- Pricing mismatch / revenue recognition lag: involve Finance early and schedule reconciliation window.
- Regional regulatory blocking (e.g., data residency for EU): flag Private deployment SKU as fallback and update listing FAQs.

Next steps (this week):
1) Finalize short and long descriptions and deliver to Design by 2026-03-12.
2) Complete icon & screenshot set for all marketplaces by 2026-03-15.
3) Run initial AWS marketplace staging submission and capture validation logs by 2026-03-17.
4) Draft release notes cross-link and submit to Docs for review by 2026-03-16.

Notes: This ticket is intended to be the cross-cloud coordination hub — detailed technical work should remain in ENG tickets (listed in dependencies) and design assets in DES tickets. Use this ticket to track signoffs, timeline changes, and any go/no-go decisions for launch day.
